title: The Melody of the Mountains at Dusk
intro: Listen as valleys echo with praise alongside a chosen servant of Allah. A voice gifted with melody, a judgment sought by disputants at the chamber, and metal softened by divine command await discovery. Which figure of worship and just rule speaks through these signs?
clues: I was blessed by Allah with bounty and a melodious voice of praise.
I was taught by Allah to understand the language of just judgment between disputants.
I faced a mighty giant warrior in battle and by Allah's will I prevailed over them.
I was given wisdom, authority and a revealed scripture of psalms from Allah.
I was joined by the mountains and the birds in glorifying Allah with me in the evening and at sunrise.
I was taught by Allah to fashion coats of mail from iron that was made soft for me.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Dawud (David)
Prophet Ismail (Ishmael)
Prophet Yahya (John)
Dhul-Kifl
Prophet Al-Yasa (Elisha)

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Defeated Jalut (Goliath) in battle by Allah's will
Built the Ark to survive the great flood
Was thrown into a fire that Allah made cool
Was swallowed by a great fish in the sea
Was raised to the heavens without tasting death
trial.answer: Defeated Jalut (Goliath) in battle by Allah's will

location.label: Key Element
options: Mountains and birds joining in praise of Allah
A staff that turned into a serpent
A fire that became cool and peaceful
A she-camel sent as a sign to the people
A wooden Ark resting on Mount Judi
location.answer: Mountains and birds joining in praise of Allah

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Granted kingship, wisdom, and the Zabur (Psalms)
Granted a son in old age after earnest prayer
Granted safety in the cave for many years
Granted a spring of Zamzam in the desert
Granted drowning of the army in the sea
outcome.answer: Granted kingship, wisdom, and the Zabur (Psalms)

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
